name: Sirius A
notes: Sirius system position and physical properties use Bond et al. (2017), including the adopted 378.9 mas parallax. The component offset is below this catalog's spatial precision. Motion: system motion shared by A and B; Hipparcos proper motion (SIMBAD HIP 32349; 2007A&A...474..653V) and true systemic RV -8.47 km/s from Bond et al. (2017) section V.1. No binary orbital motion; Galactic conversion documented in README.

name: Sirius B
notes: Sirius system position and white-dwarf properties use Bond et al. (2017). The component offset is below this catalog's spatial precision. Motion: inherited Sirius system motion as for A; Hipparcos proper motion (2007A&A...474..653V) and true systemic RV -8.47 km/s from Bond et al. (2017) section V.1. Not the white dwarf's gravitationally redshifted RV; no binary orbital motion.
